body: Commit 0efade4 (+ CHANGELOG 704ab21): founder reported live 'i think it shows the wrong team winning' -> 'i think the color of the bar ticking up may just be wrong.' Verified the actual win-condition/simulation logic first via a live isolated match with temporary debug instrumentation (lowered ARENA_RESOURCE_CAP + a debug print in arena_bot logging each bot's own team/winner/resources/verdict) -- confirmed correct across all 20 bots, debug changes fully reverted after (zero diff). Real bug: the S170-153 resource bar hardcoded team 0=blue/team 1=red regardless of local viewer's own team, same absolute-vs-relative mistake S170-149 already fixed for node coloring. Fixed to color relative to viewer (mine always blue, opponent always red).
title: S170-159: resource-race bar color was absolute, not viewer-relative
